I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I told her I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not the date in her #north-team post this morning. I also offered to post the correction in #north-team if she wants that.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't change or post anything else. I also didn't open #north-team to look at her earlier post. A renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so repeating it in this channel didn't need approval.
